For [dataframe](/docs/shell/commands/categories/dataframe/).

<div class='command-title'>Creates a min expression or aggregates columns to their min value.</div>

> **warning This command requires a plugin**
> The `polars min` command resides in the `polars` plugin.
> To use this command, you must install and register `nu_plugin_polars`.
> See the [Plugins](/docs/shell/book/plugins/) chapter in the book for more information.



## Command Type

`plugin`

## Signature

```> polars min {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input             | output            |
| ----------------- | ----------------- |
| polars_expression | polars_expression |
| polars_selector   | polars_expression |
| polars_dataframe  | polars_dataframe  |
| polars_lazyframe  | polars_lazyframe  |
## Examples

Min value from columns in a dataframe
```nu
> [[a b]; [6 2] [1 4] [4 1]] | polars into-df | polars min
╭───┬───┬───╮
│ # │ a │ b │
├───┼───┼───┤
│ 0 │ 1 │ 1 │
╰───┴───┴───╯

```

Min aggregation for a group-by
```nu
> [[a b]; [one 2] [one 4] [two 1]]
                | polars into-df
                | polars group-by a
                | polars agg (polars col b | polars min)
                | polars collect
                | polars sort-by a
╭───┬─────┬───╮
│ # │  a  │ b │
├───┼─────┼───┤
│ 0 │ one │ 2 │
│ 1 │ two │ 1 │
╰───┴─────┴───╯

```
